description: Core Guards - Security and SOLID enforcement hooks (enforcement + lifecycle delegated to @fusengine/harness) | PreToolUse[0]: Harness: guards (security/bash-write/git/install/interface-separation/protected-path), file-size, APEX gates (freshness/doc/solid/brainstorm), MCP+WebFetch cache & verbosity cap. Matcher restricted to the enforced tools — Read/Glob/Grep are NOT routed here (the APEX gate keys off filePath presence and would wrongly deny plain reads). | PostToolUse[0]: Harness: record agent/doc/ref-read activity + MCP cache store + file-size warn, PLUS (Write/Edit) cumulative session-change tracking → sniper reminder + eslint/prettier report. One harness call (ports track-session-changes.py + post-edit-typescript.py). | SessionStart[0]: Harness: inject ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md + dev context (git/project type) and run cache/state cleanups (ports the four session-start/*.py into one call) | UserPromptSubmit[0]: Harness: read ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (+ APEX preamble on dev verbs) injected as additionalContext AND detect creation intent → set brainstorm-required flag. One harness call does both. | SubagentStart[0]: Harness: inject fresh MCP cache (Context7/Exa) entries into the sub-agent prompt (ports inject-context-cache.py) | SubagentStop[0]: Harness: track agent completion + memory and emit sniper reminder on code changes (ports track-agent-memory.py) | TeammateIdle[0]: Harness: suggest sniper validation when a teammate modified code before going idle (ports validate-teammate-output.py) | TaskCompleted[0]: Harness: re-measure the task's modified code files and flag SOLID violations over the line ceiling (ports task-completed/validate-task-solid.py) | PostToolUseFailure[0]: Harness: log tool failures to ~/.claude/logs/tool-failures.log (ports log-tool-failure.py) | Stop[0]: Sound notification when Claude finishes responding (not on user interrupt), via harness --sound stop | Stop[0].hooks[0]: Harness: play task completion sound (embedded assets/song/, exits before stdin read) | Stop[1]: Lead-Stop guards in scope core (PRD cross-check block-once + compact hint — FUSE_PRD=1 plus an apex/prd.json router in the project), reached because this entry reads stdin (hook #1 exits in maybePlaySound() before stdin is read, so it never reaches them). Sound is cut via `bun --env-file=harness-quiet.env`, which sets FUSE_HARNESS_SOUND=0 in process.env before the script runs — the harness dotenv loader preserves process.env, so ~/.claude/.env cannot re-enable it — muting the stopCore→notify("stop") path that harness 0.1.94 calls unconditionally without --sound, so it does NOT double hook #1's --sound stop. The `bun …` form (no leading env var) is required by hooks-harness-exclusive.test.ts. Without FUSE_PRD this entry prints nothing and exits 0. | Stop[1].hooks[0]: Harness: lead-Stop guards, muted via --env-file (FUSE_HARNESS_SOUND=0, completion sound stays on hook #1) | Stop[2]: Verify APEX workflow completion before stopping. IMPORTANT: never convert this to a `hook claude-code core` command call without --sound — that path also triggers stopCore→notify("stop"), which would double up with hook #1's --sound stop. | Stop[2].hooks[0]: Verify APEX workflow completion before stopping | PermissionRequest[0]: Sound for ALL permission dialogs (system + hook-triggered), via harness --sound permission | PermissionRequest[0].hooks[0]: Harness: play permission request sound (embedded assets/song/, exits before stdin read) | PreCompact[0]: Harness: back up .claude/apex/task.json before compaction, keep 5 newest (ports save-apex-state.py) | SessionEnd[0]: Harness: remove stale temp/legacy cache files on session end (ports cleanup-session.py) | InstructionsLoaded[0]: Harness: log loaded instruction files for APEX debugging (ports validate-rules-loaded.py) | Notification[0]: Sound for permission requests (Bash, Write, Edit confirmations), via harness --sound permission | Notification[0].hooks[0]: Harness: play permission request sound (embedded assets/song/, exits before stdin read) | Notification[1]: Sound when Claude waits for user input (60+ sec idle), via harness --sound human | Notification[1].hooks[0]: Harness: play idle/waiting sound (embedded assets/song/, exits before stdin read) | Notification[2]: Sound for MCP tool elicitation dialogs, via harness --sound human | Notification[2].hooks[0]: Harness: play elicitation dialog sound (embedded assets/song/, exits before stdin read)

hooks.prompt: Check if the assistant followed the APEX workflow. Look for: 1) Was an explore/research agent launched before coding? 2) Were files kept under 100 lines? 3) Was sniper validation run after modifications? 4) For code changes: was elicitation self-review (APEX 3.5) run and its findings addressed BEFORE sniper? 5) Was functional verification (APEX eXAMINE Phase 4, Manual Testing — the change actually works, acceptance criteria re-checked) completed before considering the task done? If any step was missed AND code was modified, respond with {"ok": false, "reason": "Missing step: [describe what was missed]"}. If no code was modified or all steps were followed, respond with {"ok": true}. Context: $ARGUMENTS
